entities.title: Online play in the browser
entities.summary: Carry Net.gd's commands and events over the games hub's match relay (/games/multiplayer/match/ID), as Double Cross does, so invited players can play together from the browser. The hub's lobby reads multiplayer games from /games/games.json, which leaves invited games out, so icelander.net needs a way to offer an invited game to holders of its role.

origin.description: The web build has no UDP, so online games are desktop-only in the first release.
